No messages were found in the provided data that indicate Li Hua directly asked Jennifer to change his Thursday class to Friday. However, there is a conversation in which Li Hua mentions an unexpected work meeting on the following day and asks if he could reschedule his training session to Friday instead. This is noted in the third source entry:

```
1,"Time: 20260211_19:00
LiHua: Hey Jennifer! Sorry for the last-minute change, but I have an unexpected work meeting tomorrow. Can we reschedule our training session to Friday instead? Let me know if that works for you. Thanks!
JenniferMoore: No worries at all! Friday works for me. What time are you thinking? Let's make sure we crush that session! 💪
LiHua: Awesome! How about the same time, 10:00 am? Looking forward to it!
JenniferMoore: 10:00 am is perfect! Looking forward to seeing you then. Enjoy the rest of your day! 🌟"
```

From this exchange, it is clear that Jennifer agreed to the rescheduling to Friday at 10:00 AM, but there is no mention of changing the class specifically from Thursday to Friday. Li Hua only inquired about rescheduling the training session, not the class itself.
